verdict.rationale: Snyk's CLI is on GitHub and its docs/APIs are described, but nothing in the evidence pack indicates the core product source (scanning engine, Snyk Code, Snyk Open Source, etc.) is released under an open-source license; the CLI repo's license terms are never mentioned. Community evidence even flags aggressive IP/licensing terms in Snyk's platform policies, reinforcing that the product is proprietary rather than openly licensed.
